Source has two subfigures a and b, each with two round electrometers and separated, facing terminal balls. English b replaces the Cyrillic source form.

Source b alone contains one upward flame tongue between the terminal balls with a short nozzle underneath. Use generated semantic flame artwork and deterministic nozzle; no extra gas supply apparatus.

No visible + or - labels exist in the original PNG. Explicit + left / - right in a are modern text-bound additions from p0250#7 and p0251#3. b retains small nonzero deflection, not an exact-zero or recharged state.

modernAdditions: Use English a and b and short condition headings Dry air / Flame-heated air, corresponding to p0250#7, p0251#3 and p0251#4.
Add + and - over the first pair only from p0250#7 and p0251#3. Do not imply the second pair is continuously held at fixed potential, exactly uncharged, or recharges itself.

Regularize circular instrument faces, tripod feet and unnumbered scale-mark spacing. The scale marks are qualitative marks, not a newly calibrated numeric scale; no exact source division count can be read reliably where ink merges.
Use clean generated raster flame artwork only; retain exact terminals, separated gap, nozzle and dial geometry in JSXGraph. The flame has no labels, arrow or electrical overlay.
Use a 640px instructional scroll canvas to keep every English label readable; 310/331px are clipping windows, not reduced media widths.
